The Logistics Lowdown

Join us as we explore the latest insights, trends, and statistics shaping the supply chain and logistics world. Hosted by industry experts, each episode features discussions with guest speakers, offering a closer look at key topics impacting today's industry.

Your Supply Chain is Only as Strong as Your Last Shipment

73% of merchants absorb losses from shipping issues, often due to disputes or lack of coverage. Don’t let that be you.

Get a Quote Learn How it Works

Your Supply Chain is Only as Strong as Your Last Shipment

The Cost of One Failed Shipment

The Cost of One Failed Shipment

Lost, damaged, or delayed shipments can directly impact your revenue, reputation, and customer relationships. With complex logistics, from multi-carrier management to oversized deliveries, you can't afford the risk.

  • Missed delivery windows can jeopardize contracts.
  • Damaged goods can stall production lines.
  • Delays can erode customer trust.

And with 61% of consumers now holding merchants more accountable than carriers, the pressure is on to make it right -  fast.

How InsureShield® Protection Works for Your Business

How InsureShield® Protection Works for Your Business

  1. Comprehensive Coverage: From small parcels to large freight, protect against loss, damage, concealed damage, and theft.
  2. Fast, Hassle-Free Claims: File a claim in minutes through our online portal. With the highest-rated NPS score in shipping insurance, we pay 97% of approved claims within days.
  3. Peace of Mind: Recover up to the invoice value so you can reship immediately and keep your customers happy.

                                                                                                                              The Cost of One Failed Shipment

                                                                                                                              The Cost of One Failed Shipment

                                                                                                                              Lost, damaged, or delayed shipments can directly impact your revenue, reputation, and customer relationships. With complex logistics, from multi-carrier management to oversized deliveries, you can't afford the risk.

                                                                                                                              • Missed delivery windows can jeopardize contracts.
                                                                                                                              • Damaged goods can stall production lines.
                                                                                                                              • Delays can erode customer trust.

                                                                                                                              And with 61% of consumers now holding merchants more accountable than carriers, the pressure is on to make it right -  fast.

                                                                                                                              How InsureShield® Protection Works for Your Business

                                                                                                                              How InsureShield® Protection Works for Your Business

                                                                                                                              1. Comprehensive Coverage: From small parcels to large freight, protect against loss, damage, concealed damage, and theft.
                                                                                                                              2. Fast, Hassle-Free Claims: File a claim in minutes through our online portal. With the highest-rated NPS score in shipping insurance, we pay 97% of approved claims within days.
                                                                                                                              3. Peace of Mind: Recover up to the invoice value so you can reship immediately and keep your customers happy.
